result:
QA-29129 is a PASS: all four assertions held across all 132 LinkedIn posts for UCLA / University of California, Los Angeles, Impressions data set, Last 30 Days (Sep 25 – Oct 24, 2026).

- **Impressions:** Organic + Paid equals Impressions on every post. Paid Impressions is "–" throughout, treated as 0.
- **Reach:** every post shows "–" for Reach, Organic Reach and Paid Reach, so the sum check holds only vacuously.
- **Engagement Rate:** Engagements / Impressions matches on every post, with a maximum deviation of 0.005 pp.
- **Engaged User Rate:** "–" on all 132 posts.

No brand is named exactly "UCLA". I used the account's own brand, "University of California, Los Angeles", picked by exact name from the typeahead, as the earlier QA-29127 run did. The report records this under Rule 1.

The report is at `results/2026-10-26/QA-29129-report.md`. Screenshots are in `.playwright-out/QA-29129/`; the folder also holds a few leftover files from an earlier aborted attempt.

I noted one finding for `harvest.sh` (skill maintenance was not done in this run). The date picker's "Make a Selection" dropdown has Last 7/30/90 Days presets. Picking one applies immediately, with no Ok click.
